Keep Android Open

Self-hosted F-Droid repository for Keep Android Open, an unofficial, non-commercial awareness app about Google's Android developer verification program. All apps here are built by the app author from public source code.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://tsunderswapelnina.github.io/keepandroidopen-fdroid/repo
